title: `format` of `error`

source.note: composed: negative case for Table 1. Ecma's reference Python SDK emits `format: "error"`; Table 1 lists six values and `error` is not among them, so the crate rejects it (README, "format: 'error' is not a format"). The error indication the standard does show is MessageType `Error` on a text message — ECMA-432 §11, case ecma-432/05-error-message.
